title: CERN OPENLAB Summer Student Programme 2027
about: The call for applications for the 2027 CERN openlab summer student programme in Geneva, Switzerland, is open to Bachelor's and Master's students with a strong computing profile. Applications go through the CERN career portal; no closing date is published.
requirements: Bachelor or Master student (not PhD) with a strong computing profile
Students expecting to graduate during European summer 2027 (as of May) are also eligible
All requested documents must be ready when starting the application on the career portal

upskill.name: the AI for Developers Academy page
why: Requirement "Bachelor or Master student (not PhD) with a strong computing profile" → AI for Developers Academy: "Help software teams use AI across the development lifecycle and build AI-powered applications". No single course matched the stated requirements (shortlist matched only generic words), so the post links to the Academy page, not a specific course.
